notes.title: A Small Second Anniversary Patch (v1.1.5)
notes.content:
Hello again! Almost [i]another[/i] whole year has passed since [i]Remeowstered[/i] launched! As a small celebration, a new patch with some fixes, adjustments, and additions has been released.

Here are the full patch notes (v1.1.5):
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where charged swats weren’t working
[*] Fixed a bug where an empty photos UI would show on the pawse screen
[*] Fixed a bug where procedural goals could have photo rewards when all photos had been collected
[*] Updated flying insect movement to prevent it from going too high or under the floor
[*] Increased the maximum camera sensitivity value again
[*] Added achievement descriptions to the HUD pop-up
[*] Added a different icon to the energy meter while using catnip
[*] Added functionality to open the Steam Overlay when pressing a controller’s home button
[*] Added support for Steam Dynamic Cloud Sync
[/list]

(This patch will go live on consoles over the coming days.)

As always, thanks for enjoying the game and being the best cats you can be! :nippy2: :wil2: :lyn2:

notes.title: Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered turns 1! 🎉🃏😻
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Birthday, [i]Remeowstered[/i]![/h1]

Can you believe [i]Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered[/i] launched [b]a whole year ago[/b]? Who even knows what time is anymore?!

To celebrate, the game now has [b]Trading Card[/b] drops and their related rewards like badges, backgrounds, and emoticons. In addition, you can collect cat-themed items from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1237730/][b]Points Shop[/b][/url] for [i]Remeowstered[/i] like animated backgrounds, frames, and chat stickers. Oh, and the game will be [b]50% off[/b] for a limited time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900995/57c70076c41a236f64afe2ff9b65c0bfa0a8cf73.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900995/1130293b8f976af988d87a1636f523de68aac6ff.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900995/77923aea52d0592e4359688ef502077764b3ff94.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900995/9a08675a317553ad6a1ce7ffd862427f1937174b.png[/img]

Lastly, the game has been updated with two new playable cats: [b]Oreo[/b] and [b]Pandora[/b]. You may recognize Oreo as the star of our launch trailer; Pandora is her fluffier sister!

[previewyoutube=HWhL3Vd5u0s;full][/previewyoutube]
Here are the full patch notes for this update (v1.1.4):
[list]
[*] Added Oreo and Pandora as playable cats
[*] Added a collection screen for viewing achievements
[*] Fixed an issue with the UVs on the left first-person paw mesh
[*] Made a small fix to a cat texture
[*] Fixed a bug where invisible UI elements could be highlighted
[*] Fixed a bug where remapped actions could get in an improper state
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has played the game over the past year, and keep on knocking stuff onto the floor!
:nippy2: :wil2: :lyn2:

notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with opening presents in the Pawliday Den level
[*] Fixed some objects not counting when put inside trash bins
[*] Fixed a potential hang when loading levels in Procedural mode
[*] Fixed a bug where treats could be eaten more than once
[*] Fixed a bug where the goals count on the Pawse screen was incorrect
[*] Fixed the machine levers in the Furightful Lab level
[*] Fixed missing models on Modern Home windows
[*] Fixed the glass material on the Modern Home fireplace
[*] Increased the maximum camera sensitivity value
[*] Increased UI animation speed on level end screen
[*] Made mouse and moth goals in Procedural mode a bit easier
[*] Updated some names in the credits
[*] Fixed a bug where keyboard controls mapping wouldn't save properly
[*] Fixed a bug where the Furiends and Family achievement wouldn't unlock immediately
[*] Added the ability to speed up the level end screen by holding Left Mouse Button (or A or B on a controller)
[*] Added the ability to speed up the level start camera animation by holding Left Mouse Button (or A or B on a controller)
[*] Added a hidden option for deleting save data in-game (Ctrl + Shift + Del or Left Stick Button + Right Stick Button on a controller while on the Gameplay Options screen)
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs with some achievement logic
[*] Fixed a bug where random photos weren't selected properly in Procedural Mode
[*] Fixed a bug where bonus level keys could be found in Litter Box Mode
[*] Fixed a bug where tutorial prompts could display incorrect inputs
[*] Fixed a bug where the credits would appear multiple times after completing Goals mode
[*] Adjusted object placement chances in Procedural Mode
[*] Added [b]qualityLevel[/b] (0-3, low to high) and [b]renderDistance[/b] (0-2, near to far) settings for adjusting game performance (currently must be changed by manually editing the settings.json file)
[/list]
